messages:
Ben: Heads up — planning to run the users table schema migration + staggered backfill tonight at 23:00 UTC. Dual-write window enabled for 4h. Canaries first 23:00-23:15, then gradual ramp. No planned downtime. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/users-schema-backfill

Tara: ACK. I'll own the backfill job sequencing and watch query perf. I'll be on standby from 22:50 — ping me for any shove/stop.

Samir: I can handle the canary deploy and traffic ramp. Will watch p99 and write latencies. FYI I'll be on phone 23:30-23:45 but reachable for rollback decisions.

Maria: Adding smoke checks — please run this from canary box after deploy:
```
# smoke write
curl -sS -XPOST $CANARY_URL/v1/users -d '{"test_user":true}'
# verify read
curl -sS $CANARY_URL/v1/users/test_user | jq .id
```
Also check replica lag and backfill progress query: `SELECT job_id, processed_rows, state FROM backfills WHERE target='users' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 5;`

oncall-sre: What are rollback thresholds? Recommend auto-rollback if replica lag > 5s for 2 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 3% on canary writes. Also want DB connections spike > 20% to trigger alert.

Ben: Good call. Rollback plan: 1) Pause backfill jobs, 2) flip dual-write -> write_to_new=false (traffic stays on old code), 3) revert schema migration if quick fix needed (we have hotfix branch), 4) follow post-rollback smoke checklist. If thresholds hit, call it.

Tara: Confirmed backfill can pause within ~30s of command. I'll keep a manual throttle handle ready.

Samir: I'll set the deploy-bot window to canary 10% for 15m then 50% for 30m => full. I'll also add an automated rollback hook using the thresholds Maria/oncall suggested.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Deploy scheduled by Samir at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z (canary 10% -> ramp). Link: https://ci.redwood/deploys/3456

Ben: Quick checklist before we go:
- [x] Migration SQL reviewed (PR #4478)
- [x] Backfill job tested in staging
- [x] Metrics dashboard (users-migration) pinned
- [x] Pager/SRE notified (oncall-sre)
- [ ] Final ack from product if anything user-visible (product pinged)

Maria: I'll monitor metrics and post periodic updates in this thread (every 10m during ramp). Will call out any anomalies immediately.

Tara: ACK. Ready on my side. :thumbsup:

Samir: Ready. Will start canary at :00. Going to mark my phone as priority.

Ben: Thanks all — I'll post final "started" and "canary success" messages here.

(10m later) Maria: Started canary writes at 23:00. No errors so far, p50 write=12ms, p99 write=110ms, replica lag=0.4s.

(25m later) Samir: Canary success. Ramping to 50% now. No rollback needed so far.

(1h later) Tara: Backfill progressing, ~18% done after 45m. No query hotspots.

(3h later) Ben: Backfill complete, dual-write window expired at 03:00 UTC. Final verification done. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
